caption_used: Хоризонтална стълбовидна диаграма, представяща честотата на посочване на мерки за ограничаване на скритата икономика в България. Най-високо оценената мярка е „Да се намали корупцията“ с около 18%, следвана от „Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система“ с 15%. Мерките „Да се засили данъчния контрол“ и „Да се приемат по-строги закони“ заемат средни позиции с по около 7–8%. Най-рядко посочваните мерки включват „Да се засили граничния контрол“ и „Да се намалят акцизите“, всяка с 2%.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The horizontal bar chart illustrates the frequency with which various measures are cited as effective in limiting the "hidden economy" in the country, based on survey responses. The vertical axis lists 11 categorical options, each describing a potential policy action, arranged in descending order of frequency of mention. The horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents selecting each measure, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to approximately 18%, marked at intervals of 2%. Each category is represented by a colored bar extending from left to right, with the corresponding percentage value displayed at the end of the bar. The bars are color-coded: blue for measures such as "Strengthen border control" (2%), "Reduce customs duties" (2%), "Strengthen tax control" (9%), and "Introduce stricter laws" (5%), and red for measures including "Limit mafia activities" (10%), "Reduce corruption" (18%), and "Improve judicial system efficiency" (15%). The chart shows that the most frequently cited measure is "Reduce corruption" with a value of 18%, followed by "Improve judicial system efficiency" at 15%. The least frequently cited measures are "Strengthen border control" and "Reduce excise duties," both at 2%. The bars are arranged in descending order of frequency, with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or annotations.
